floor_history.headline: Recon baseline 18 (91 vs 91 insns, pure RA+sched). Cluster-A callee-save rotation mechanism CONFIRMED via cc1 -da: the goto-loop emits no NOTE_INSN_LOOP_BEG, so allocno_compare ranks the param above t

Cluster A SOLVED — a real loop plus ONE reused scratch local holding both loop-invariant compare constants defeats loop.c's hoisting and lands target's exact $s0-$s3 map with only four callee-saves; f

Floor still 18/92; the whole residual is the tail. Found jump.c:1764 (bare-goto exit reproduces target's beqz sense), KILLED every exit-spelling/label-order variant (8 forms, byte-identical 19/93), pr

frontier.hypothesis: The whole remaining +2 is one reorg own-thread steal: in the bare-goto form the `return 0;` block is stranded, while the structurally identical `return -1;` block in the same function IS consumed into its branch's delay slot.
frontier.mechanism: RTL tail is `jump_insn 173: beq v0,0 -> label 205` / `insn 252 = SEQUENCE[jump_insn 184: beq s2,0 -> loop ; insn 194: v0=1]` / `jump_insn 196: j 218` / `code_label 205` / `insn 208: (set (reg/i:SI 2 v0) (const_int 0))` / `code_label 218`. Two differences from the consumed case: the consumed thread ends in a jump_insn to 218 whereas 208 is followed directly by code_label 218; and 173's fall-through (next_active_insn) is the loop-condition JUMP_INSN 184, already a SEQUENCE from fill_simple_delay_slots, whereas the flag branch's fall-through is an ordinary INSN.
frontier.next_probe: Read fill_slots_from_thread's trial-loop guards in tools/gcc-2.7.2/reorg.c, especially `! insn_sets_resource_p (trial, &opposite_needed, 1)` and the mark_target_live_regs fallback at reorg.c:2500-2510 that force-marks ALL registers live when it cannot find the block start (the BB2_ALLLIVE_LABEL hook suggests this project has hit it before). Then find C that either puts an ordinary INSN between the mask branch and the loop-condition branch, or leaves the `return 0;` thread ending in a real jump. Regenerate RTL with `bash tmp/grind/saEft01Init/s3/dbr.sh <variant>`. Note w2 (which keeps `ret = 1;` before the loop condition) does NOT achieve this — fill_simple_delay_slots consumes that insn into 184's slot before fill_eager reaches 173.

frontier.hypothesis: The 0x3C0000 constant can be made to escape LICM in its OWN pseudo (giving target's two-register shape and retiring the synthetic `k` reuse) by satisfying loop.c:695's gate for it as well.
frontier.mechanism: loop.c:695 needs all three branches false: maybe_never already 1 at the set (or the register REFERENCED earlier in the loop than its set, which is the loop_reg_used_before_p half of branch A and does not need maybe_never), the dest a user variable, and the live range crossing a basic-block boundary. Today the only in-loop branch before the timeout compare is `if (D_800F19B8 < v0)` and the compare follows in the same block, so either A or C always holds.
frontier.next_probe: Spellings that put an extra branch or label between the constant's set and its use; a variable referenced earlier in the loop than its set; or restructuring so the D_800F19BC read/increment sits in its own block. Success looks like 91-92 insns with $s4/$s5 absent from the .greg dispositions and `lui $v0,0x3c` / `lui $v1,0x100` in two different caller-saved registers. Screen with tmp/grind/saEft01Init/s3/score.py.
